description: The map \(x\mapsto x+1\) on \(\mathbb R\) is bijective. For every real \(y\), \(y-1\) maps to \(y\), and any \(x\) with \(x+1=y\) equals \(y-1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.SetsAndMaps.real_translation_bijective :
  (Function.Bijective fun x => x + 1) ∧ ∀ (y : ℝ), y - 1 + 1 = y ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ), x + 1 = y → x = y - 1
